corporate_summary.title: Corporate Profile & Global Transactions
corporate_summary.description: Esyasoft Holding Limited (alongside its specialized subsidiaries) has aggressively expanded its footprint across smart grids, IoT utilities, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, and renewable energy ecosystems. Supported by major backing from Abu Dhabi’s International Holding Company (IHC) via Sirius International Holding, the group has secured major acquisitions, joint ventures, and strategic Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs).

stories.title: TESLA & ESYASOFT COLLABORATE GLOBALLY TO DEPLOY 15 GWh+ BATTERY ENERGY STORAGE SOLUTIONS
stories.author: Clean Energy & Storage Bureau
stories.image_caption: Executive signing ceremony: Bipin Chandra, Founder & Group CEO of Esyasoft Holding, with Tesla leadership finalizing the multi-gigawatt battery energy storage deployment alliance.
stories.excerpt: In an unprecedented clean energy alliance, Tesla and Esyasoft collaborate globally to integrate and deploy multi-gigawatt battery energy storage solutions (BESS) exceeding 15 GWh into active macro-grid modernization efforts across the UK, Western Europe, GCC, and India under the co-brand 'Esyasoft Energy Storage powered by Tesla'.
stories.content:
In one of the most consequential clean tech pacts of the decade, American clean energy titan Tesla and smart grid leader Esyasoft Holding have entered into a monumental strategic partnership to integrate and deploy over 15 GWh of utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) into active macro-grid modernization efforts globally.

Operating under the dedicated co-brand "Esyasoft Energy Storage powered by Tesla", the multi-year program pairs Tesla's cutting-edge Megapack battery hardware and power electronics with Esyasoft's AI-driven energy management software, sub-second telemetry backbones, and turnkey utility grid engineering.

The joint initiative specifically targets four high-demand regional corridors experiencing massive renewable curtailment and surging load growth:

  • United Kingdom & Western Europe: Providing dynamic frequency containment, wholesale power market arbitrage, and buffering offshore wind intermittency.
  • Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC): Supporting sovereign net-zero commitments and cooling-driven desert peak load management across UAE and Saudi Arabia.
  • India: Reinforcing state transmission nodes and balancing rapid solar park expansions under national grid resilience mandates.
  • Mission-Critical AI Infrastructure: Offering dedicated multi-megawatt firming solutions for high-density generative AI and cloud hyperscaler data centres.
"Deploying 15 GWh with Tesla represents more than just capacity—it is the foundational stabilizing architecture for the AI era and decarbonized global energy networks. By combining Tesla Megapacks with Esyasoft's predictive grid AI, we are solving the intermittency bottleneck at planetary scale."
— Leadership Conclave, Esyasoft Clean Energy Division

stories.title: CYANCONNODE HOLDINGS PLC £36.5M CASH ACQUISITION COMPLETED WITH OVER 96% SHAREHOLDER APPROVAL
stories.author: Global M&A & Energy Desk
stories.image_caption: CyanConnode's narrowband RF mesh communication modules integrated into Esyasoft's cloud-native Head-End and MDM product catalog.
stories.excerpt: Esyasoft Technologies UK Limited executed an all-cash acquisition scheme valued at £36.5 million (10.165p per share) to buy out CyanConnode. Shareholders overwhelmingly approved the transaction with over 96% in favor, consolidating prominent regional smart-metering and narrowband RF mesh modules into Esyasoft’s primary product catalog.
stories.content:
Consolidating its global dominance across Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), Esyasoft Technologies UK Limited executed an all-cash acquisition scheme valued at £36.5 million (10.165p per share) to buy out AIM-listed CyanConnode Holdings PLC.

Shareholders overwhelmingly approved the court-sanctioned transaction, with over 96% voting in favor. The acquisition consolidates CyanConnode's prominent regional smart-metering and narrowband RF mesh communication modules directly into Esyasoft’s primary product catalog.

CyanConnode has deployed over 6.5 million endpoints across Indian utilities alone under the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS). By uniting CyanConnode's hardware modules with Esyasoft's high-throughput Head-End Systems (HES) and Meter Data Management (MDM), Esyasoft establishes an unrivaled vertically integrated smart metering supply chain.

stories.title: GOOD ENERGY GROUP PLC £99.4M BUYOUT COMPLETED TRANSITIONING ESYASOFT TO DIGITAL ENERGY-AS-A-SERVICE
stories.author: European M&A Intelligence Desk
stories.image_caption: Good Energy's UK headquarters in Chippenham, functioning as the premier vehicle for Esyasoft's European digital Energy-as-a-Service operations.
stories.excerpt: Esyasoft acquired 100% of the share capital of UK-based renewable electricity pioneer Good Energy for roughly £99.4 million (490p per share). The strategic buyout transitions Esyasoft into a full-scale digital 'Energy-as-a-Service' (EaaS) provider.
stories.content:
In a milestone transaction sanctioned by the High Court of Justice in London, Esyasoft concluded the acquisition of 100% of the share capital of Good Energy Group PLC for approximately £99.4 million (490p per share in cash).

The strategic buyout decisively transitions Esyasoft into a full-scale digital "Energy-as-a-Service" (EaaS) provider, bringing over 25 years of pedigree in 100% renewable electricity supply, residential solar rooftop installations, domestic heat pumps, and smart EV dynamic tariffs.

Esyasoft confirmed that Good Energy preserves its brand autonomy and continues operations from Chippenham, spearheading European green power operations backed by Esyasoft's smart grid AI.

stories.title: ESYASOFT ACQUIRES 70% CONTROLLING STAKE IN DUTCH SMART WATER INNOVATOR FLOAT IOT
stories.author: Smart Water & Municipal Utilities Desk
stories.image_caption: Float IoT's Dutch ultrasonic smart water telemetry network integrated into Esyasoft's multi-utility municipal platform.
stories.excerpt: Esyasoft purchased a 70% controlling stake in Float, a Netherlands-based smart water technology provider. This acquisition broadened Esyasoft’s market reach from electricity-dominated setups into international water sustainability management.
stories.content:
In an aggressive multi-utility expansion, Esyasoft Holding completed the purchase of a 70% controlling stake in Float, an innovative Netherlands-based smart water technology pioneer.

This strategic acquisition significantly broadens Esyasoft’s market reach from electricity-dominated setups into international municipal water sustainability management, ultrasonic smart water metering, acoustic leak detection, and Non-Revenue Water (NRW) loss reduction.

Float's proprietary battery-powered telemetry devices and cloud software are currently being rolled out across municipal water boards in the GCC and Western Europe, connecting directly into Esyasoft's unified utility command platform.

stories.title: ADANI ENERGY SOLUTIONS & ESYASOFT SCALE 20M+ SMART ENDPOINTS UNDER 51:49 JV ENTITY
stories.author: Capital Markets & Infrastructure Bureau
stories.image_caption: Executive engineering conclave reviewing telemetry data pipelines for the Adani Esyasoft smart meter joint venture.
stories.excerpt: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd (AESL) and Esyasoft established Adani Esyasoft Smart Solutions Ltd under a 51% Esyasoft / 49% Adani ownership structure to deploy smart metering software, load forecasting, and grid efficiency software globally.
stories.content:
In one of the most consequential joint ventures in the subcontinental utility sector, Adani Energy Solutions Ltd (AESL) entered into an agreement with Esyasoft to form Adani Esyasoft Smart Solutions Ltd with a 51% Esyasoft / 49% Adani ownership structure.

Completed under an execution framework in April 2024, the entity focuses on developing and deploying smart metering software, predictive load forecasting, and grid efficiency software for global utility concessions.

The JV pairs Adani's massive national transmission and distribution pipeline with Esyasoft's carrier-grade HES and MDM platform, currently orchestrating over 20 million smart meter endpoints under India's national RDSS initiative.

stories.title: ESYASOFT & PRESIGHT AI FORM 'INTELLIGRID' JV TO REVOLUTIONIZE ENERGY & UTILITY NETWORKS
stories.author: Artificial Intelligence & Utilities Desk
stories.image_caption: IntelliGrid strategic alliance launched during Baku Energy Week uniting Gen-AI analytics with digital IIoT devices.
stories.excerpt: Launched during Baku Energy Week in June 2024, Esyasoft and Presight AI formed 'IntelliGrid', a strategic alliance combining Generative AI and big data analytics to deploy digital IIoT devices across gas, water, and electricity utility grids.
stories.content:
During Baku Energy Week in June 2024, Esyasoft Holding and Abu Dhabi-based big data analytics titan Presight AI announced the formation of IntelliGrid, an ambitious joint venture designed to revolutionize the global energy landscape.

IntelliGrid combines Presight's foundational Generative AI algorithms and big data engines with Esyasoft's deep domain expertise in digital Industrial IoT (IIoT) devices, smart electricity metering, and municipal water and gas distribution networks.

The alliance delivers sovereign predictive utility intelligence, enabling grid operators to autonomously detect technical losses, forecast localized surges, and secure critical infrastructure against cyber threats.

stories.title: ESYASOFT & LANDIS+GYR INDIA FORGE STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP TO BUILD ENTERPRISE MDM APPLICATIONS
stories.author: Smart Grid Engineering Cell
stories.image_caption: Esyasoft Landis+Gyr Ltd joint initiative uniting solid-state hardware manufacturing with cloud-native Meter Data Management.
stories.excerpt: Formed to build integrated enterprise Meter Data Management (MDM) applications, the Esyasoft Landis+Gyr Ltd strategic alliance includes the acquisition of Landis+Gyr’s domestic manufacturing facilities and technology cross-licensing.
stories.content:
In a definitive move reinforcing domestic smart grid manufacturing, Esyasoft and Landis+Gyr India Ltd forged a landmark strategic partnership, creating Esyasoft Landis+Gyr Ltd.

The alliance was formed to engineer next-generation enterprise Meter Data Management (MDM) applications and includes the acquisition of Landis+Gyr’s domestic manufacturing facilities in India alongside reciprocal technology cross-licensing.

By combining Landis+Gyr's globally accredited meter manufacturing footprint with Esyasoft's cloud-native MDM and automated VEE engines, the entity provides Indian Discoms with an end-to-end, 'Make in India' compliant smart metering ecosystem.

stories.title: ABB E-MOBILITY & ESYASOFT SIGN COMPREHENSIVE MOU TO ENGINEER TURNKEY EV FLEET ELECTRIFICATION
stories.author: E-Mobility & Transit Bureau
stories.image_caption: Turnkey EV fleet charging depot architectures engineered under the ABB E-mobility and Esyasoft alliance.
stories.excerpt: Esyasoft and ABB E-mobility signed a comprehensive MoU to engineer turnkey EV fleet electrification architectures targeting public transit and commercial enterprise operations across Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa.
stories.content:
Addressing the rapid transition toward zero-emission public transport, Esyasoft and global charging infrastructure pioneer ABB E-mobility ratified a comprehensive Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in February 2026.

The partnership focuses on engineering turnkey EV fleet electrification architectures, pairing ABB's ultra-fast DC high-power charging depots with Esyasoft's dynamic load management software, grid balancing algorithms, and digital fleet payment integrations.

Initial rollout frameworks prioritize large-scale municipal electric bus fleets and commercial delivery logistics operators across Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa.

stories.title: PARK+ & ESYASOFT FORM 3-YEAR, ₹100 CRORE INITIATIVE TO DEPLOY 10,000 EV CHARGING SPACES IN INDIA
stories.author: Smart Mobility & Infrastructure Cell
stories.image_caption: Smart EV charging hubs deployed within gated high-rise residential communities and commercial IT parks.
stories.excerpt: Esyasoft and auto-tech platform Park+ formed a three-year, ₹100 crore investment initiative to implement 10,000 electric vehicle charging spaces inside private residential blocks and corporate complexes in India.
stories.content:
In a major leap for decentralized EV charging accessibility, Esyasoft and auto-tech giant Park+ formed a three-year, ₹100 crore ($12M+) investment initiative.

The initiative is dedicated to deploying 10,000 smart electric vehicle charging spaces directly inside private residential high-rise communities, gated townships, and corporate tech parks across India's top metropolitan hubs.

Esyasoft provides smart energy metering, dynamic off-peak tariff automation, and Discom grid balancing, while Park+ integrates seamless discovery, slot booking, and UPI billing through its consumer app ecosystem.

stories.title: ALERIA & ESYASOFT SIGN DISTRIBUTED EDGE-AI MOU AT 'MAKE IT IN THE EMIRATES' FORUM
stories.author: Edge Computing & Industrial Tech Desk
stories.image_caption: Bilateral MoU signing at the Make it in the Emirates forum shifting computing loads to localized edge-AI smart grids.
stories.excerpt: Signed at the prestigious Make it in the Emirates forum in Abu Dhabi, Aleria and Esyasoft entered into a distributed intelligence MoU to shift heavy computing loads away from centralized systems directly to localized, edge-computing AI smart grids.
stories.content:
Abu Dhabi, UAE — During the 2026 edition of the prestigious Make it in the Emirates forum, Aleria and Esyasoft Holding entered into a pioneering distributed intelligence Memorandum of Understanding (MoU).

The agreement focuses on shifting heavy data processing and optimization loads away from centralized cloud data centers directly to localized, on-premise edge-computing AI processors embedded inside smart grid substations and industrial meters.

This decentralized architecture slashes telemetry latency to under 5 milliseconds, enabling sub-second fault isolation, microgrid self-healing, and cyber-resilient grid operations.

stories.title: ABU DHABI DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY (DOE) & ESYASOFT RATIFY WATER CONSERVATION MOU AT WORLD UTILITIES CONGRESS
stories.author: Sustainability & Resource Management Desk
stories.image_caption: World Utilities Congress ratification: Upgrading municipal water tracking frameworks through targeted smart monitoring networks.
stories.excerpt: Ratified at the World Utilities Congress, the Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) and Esyasoft formulated a strategic water conservation MoU to upgrade municipal tracking frameworks via targeted smart monitoring networks.
stories.content:
At the World Utilities Congress in Abu Dhabi, the Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) and Esyasoft ratified a high-level water conservation Memorandum of Understanding.

The collaboration establishes a formal framework to upgrade municipal consumption tracking, evaluate advanced district metering areas (DMAs), and deploy targeted smart monitoring sensor networks to eliminate distribution leakage and meet the UAE's Water Security Strategy 2036.

stories.title: ZIAD KHALAF HOLDING GROUP & ESYASOFT FORMULATE ENERGY INFRASTRUCTURE MOU FOR IRAQ RECONSTRUCTION
stories.author: Middle East Energy Transitions Desk
stories.image_caption: Bilateral infrastructure summit evaluating sustainable smart tech deployments within Iraq's transitioning energy framework.
stories.excerpt: Esyasoft and prominent Iraqi conglomerate Ziad Khalaf Holding Group formulated an energy infrastructure MoU to evaluate sustainable smart tech deployments within Iraq’s transitioning energy framework.
stories.content:
Marking a critical expansion into regional reconstruction and power grid modernization, Esyasoft and Iraq's prominent Ziad Khalaf Holding Group formulated a strategic energy infrastructure MoU.

The pact provides a roadmap to evaluate smart grid deployments, loss reduction analytics, revenue protection software, and solar-plus-storage microgrids to modernize Iraq’s national transmission and distribution network.

stories.title: BACKED BY ABU DHABI'S IHC VIA SIRIUS INTERNATIONAL, ESYASOFT ACCELERATES GLOBAL SMART GRID CONQUEST
stories.author: Executive Strategy Desk
stories.image_caption: Bipin Chandra, Founder & Group CEO, with executive partners backed by Abu Dhabi's International Holding Company (IHC) via Sirius International Holding.
stories.excerpt: Supported by major backing from Abu Dhabi’s International Holding Company (IHC) via Sirius International Holding, Esyasoft has aggressively expanded its footprint across smart grids, IoT utilities, EV infrastructure, and renewable energy ecosystems.
stories.content:
Esyasoft Holding Limited’s rapid rise from a pioneering smart grid software developer into a multi-billion dollar multinational clean tech enterprise is catalyzed by major backing from Abu Dhabi’s International Holding Company (IHC) via Sirius International Holding.

This blue-chip institutional backing has provided the strategic balance sheet power and sovereign diplomatic access that unlocked landmark acquisitions—including UK-listed CyanConnode (£36.5M), Good Energy (£99.4M), and Dutch water pioneer Float IoT (70%)—alongside Tier-1 global joint ventures with Adani, Presight AI, and Landis+Gyr, and the multi-gigawatt BESS deployment alliance with Tesla.
